description: This file defines an Android Activity named AccountsTester that provides a user interface for testing Android account management features. It supports operations such as listing accounts, adding and removing accounts, editing account properties, and handling authentication tokens. The class interacts with the Android AccountManager API and includes UI components like spinners, list views, and dialogs to facilitate these actions.

classes.name: AccountsTester
classes.description: An Android Activity class providing a UI for testing account management features, including listing, adding, removing, and manipulating accounts and auth tokens.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, adapters, and listeners.

methods.name: onAccountsUpdated
methods.description: Callback invoked when the list of accounts has been updated; updates the list view.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Registers the activity as a listener for account updates.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Unregisters the activity from account update notifications.

methods.name: getSelectedAuthenticator
methods.description: Returns the current selected AuthenticatorDescription from the spinner.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates context menu for account items, offering actions like remove, clear password, get auth token, etc.

methods.name: onContextItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selections from the account context menu, performing account actions.

methods.name: showMessageDialog
methods.description: Displays a message dialog with given text.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialogs for various account operations like get auth token, invalidate token, update credentials, etc.
